description: Two hooks, both ON by default with a documented opt-out. SessionStart (compact|resume|clear|startup): control-anchor re-injection (compaction-survival); opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0. Stop: the feedback-debt nudge, read from the session transcript; it stays silent unless a feedback-targets file resolves, so an install with no registered tools never sees it. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FEEDBACK_NUDGE=0. Both no-op paths return zero with no output. See the plugin README for the exact settings block each opt-out goes in.
